$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/markdown-artifact — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. requiredContexts names every check this repository's own workflows run on each pull request into main: the four contexts its main ruleset requires (actions-pinned-gate, gitignore-gate, source-leak-gate, secret-scan-gate) and the two further reusable gates its callers run (meta-commentary-gate from .github/workflows/docs-meta-commentary.yml, extension-conformance-gate from .github/workflows/extension-conformance-gate.yml), each carrying the reusable workflow it calls and the 40-character sha this repository's OWN caller pins for it; the build and kind-gates jobs of .github/workflows/ci.yml and the standalone-verification job of .github/workflows/standalone-verification.yml, which call no reusable workflow and so carry neither workflow nor pinned; and the truthful-attribution-gate context BY NAME with its callerPath and allowedEvents and WITHOUT a workflow/pinned pair, because its engine pin lives in that caller's uses: line (itself a high-risk path). A change that moves one of these caller pins moves the matching pinned value here in the same commit and bumps the version. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (config/high-risk-defaults.json, highRiskGlobs; the engine's classifyHighRisk fails closed unless the effective set is a superset): its first 35 globs are the defaults at cinatra-ai/ci 1e40675e1642dcc32d195f27b3deb285b4d3d6fc, identical at 416a75707fdcfeb768b41c3a54f944078d1ab8fc and fdc26811b97f435bbf8a754247631db39267a197 and a strict superset of the 28 at 8eede1022e835997d94974e4bd6205daf72131a2, the engine this repository's attribution caller pins, so the superset check passes at each of them; the rest are this package's own: package.json, whose cinatra block is the authoritative extension manifest (kind, accepted media types, renderer entries, object types) and which also carries the scripts and dependencies CI runs; extension-kind-gate.mjs, the self-contained extension validator the kind-gates check runs; src/renderers/markdown-view.ts, the one module that calls the shared markdown sanitizer, and src/renderers/markdown-document.tsx, the one place its html enters the page — the two ends of the only road from a document to markup; tests/one-sanitizer.test.ts and tests/sanitizer-conformance.test.tsx, which pin that road and what it draws; and vitest.config.ts and tsconfig.json, which resolve the sanitizer to the real SDK leaf or to a test stand-in. The other display modules, the renderer entries included, are deliberately not listed: a display-only change is not high-risk. .github/** and **/gate-suite.json are already central defaults. High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json in the defaults) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-09-24, the birth of this suite: requiredContexts was read from this repository's own workflows at base 489936be956541144154c36436d1adf466015f4a — the main ruleset (baseline-protection) requires actions-pinned-gate, gitignore-gate, source-leak-gate and secret-scan-gate, and every pull request into main also runs meta-commentary-gate, extension-conformance-gate, build, kind-gates, standalone-verification and truthful-attribution-gate — and cross-checked against the check runs of the latest pull request, cinatra-ai/markdown-artifact#4 at head c12512ba25bfa5c95036e93b3366393255c9de1d, where all 10 concluded success, each on an Actions run of that head, and each pinned context's run referenced its reusable workflow at exactly the pinned sha; each pin equals the sha this repository's own caller pins at that base (actions-pinned-gate at 4c903fe9ca71ad47752a2bc92b72893e5f7c9814, gitignore-gate at 4c903fe9ca71ad47752a2bc92b72893e5f7c9814, source-leak-gate at 00ac7b92c2ca1ca291a1824d743cbd00c4a3e48e, secret-scan-gate at a8677e50ba02fcb11929e94c70fb5ba96a8ea3ae, meta-commentary-gate at 533a12a64a596e6ce5df3887e0ebbad5a7d6b953, extension-conformance-gate at 8ccb895adcc56d130040d847ed75b2d3fedd4da3), and the attribution context is taken by name from its caller (.github/workflows/truthful-attribution-gate.yml, engine pin 8eede1022e835997d94974e4bd6205daf72131a2, warn mode); highRiskPaths was checked as a superset of the central defaults at every engine sha named in the comment; every listed context is read green on the birth pull request's own head before the maintainer's approval.
